stories.headline: Democrats win control of both houses of Congress
stories.what_happened: Democrats will control both the House and the Senate when the new Congress meets in January. Republican Speaker Mike Johnson will not lead House Republicans in the minority.
stories.why_it_matters: Congress writes laws, so the party in charge decides what it takes up.

key_facts.fact: Democrats will control both chambers of Congress when the 120th Congress convenes in January, with larger majorities.
In the House, Democrats had won at least 240 seats to Republicans' 147, with about four dozen races uncalled.
The Democratic caucus in the Senate will have at least 54 senators; Alaska and Mississippi remained too close to call.
House Speaker Mike Johnson will not seek to lead House Republicans in the next Congress after the party lost its majority.
Reps. Steve Scalise and Jim Jordan both announced bids for minority leader.
Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries will run for speaker when Congress convenes on January 3; he would be the first African American to hold the post.
Vice President JD Vance wrote on social media: "The reason we lost is the war."
Trump said the Iran war was 'largely true' as a cause because it raised gas prices in the short term.
Stocks rallied on Wednesday 4 November; the Dow rose 3% to close at 53,356.12.
Alaska: Democrat Mary Peltola led Sen. Dan Sullivan by 637 votes with nearly a quarter of ballots uncounted.

numbers.label: House seats won by Democrats (at least)

stories.headline: Oil prices drop more than 8% as hopes grow for an end to the Iran war
stories.what_happened: Crude oil fell more than 8% on Wednesday 4 November, to its lowest price since 31 August.
stories.why_it_matters: Cheaper oil can mean cheaper fuel for families.

key_facts.fact: Crude fell more than 8% on Wednesday 4 November, easing energy-inflation worries.
Brent fell $8.98, or 8.7%, to $94.62 a barrel.
WTI fell $7.97, or 8.3%, to $88.12 a barrel.
Both benchmarks reached their lowest settlements since August 31.
Hopes for an end to the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran helped stocks and pushed oil down.
Energy shares fell: the energy sector of the S&P 500 dropped 4.8%.
Trump said the war was 'largely true' as a cause of Republican losses because it raised gas prices in the short term.
Iran's Revolutionary Guard said two oil tankers and a tugboat caught fire after using unauthorized Strait of Hormuz routes.

stories.geography: Iran, United States, Strait of Hormuz

stories.headline: South Africa votes in local elections
stories.what_happened: Voting began Wednesday across all 257 municipalities.
stories.why_it_matters: Local councils run water and power.

key_facts.fact: Voting began Wednesday across all 257 municipalities.
Full results are expected Sunday.
Voters' top concerns are unreliable water and power, unemployment, crime and a shortage of affordable housing.

stories.headline: EU could finish talks with Montenegro by year end
stories.what_happened: The European Commission said the EU could conclude accession negotiations with Montenegro by the end of this year.
stories.why_it_matters: Joining the EU is a long process.

key_facts.fact: The European Commission said the EU could conclude accession negotiations with Montenegro by the end of this year and sign an accession treaty as soon as June 2027.

stories.headline: Trilateral talks planned
stories.what_happened: Zelenskyy spoke with US envoys ahead of talks.

key_facts.fact: Zelenskyy spoke for 90 minutes with U.S. Special Envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner in Brussels ahead of trilateral talks with Russia and the U.S. set for Nov. 10-11, focused on postwar recovery.
